answer: Every submission must name 3 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The inlet graph is validated at intake and the zephyr frontier is published, and as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and umber anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1854 impostors cost 1497 times the honest price and take 2 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
